notes: Song previews and single-song downloads work again on installs where the engine’s own URL encoder let them down — the module now encodes song titles itself. Mines appear in the chart preview instead of leaving a gap where a chart is telling you not to step. The Years tab stops saying it is indexing once it has finished, rather than waiting for you to open a year. The installer also finds the theme your cabinet actually loads when it lives on a mounted drive, and names the directory it wrote to.
